Catholic Priest in Ecuador Dies After Crucifix Falls During Livestreamed Mass

A Catholic priest in Ecuador died on a Saturday after a large crucifix collapsed onto him while he was conducting a Mass broadcast live online.

By LokkeeVerse · 1 min read

A Catholic priest in Ecuador has died following an incident during a religious service, according to a report from the Hindustan Times.

The priest was leading a Mass that was being broadcast live online on a Saturday when a large crucifix fell on him, resulting in his death. Further details regarding the incident were not immediately available in the initial report.
